status: tabled: kept for the world, not yet placed or referenced by code
note: The first self-portrait poll. The question framed menace as welcome, which pulled every model toward a darker twin of itself; these are those twins. The neutral poll that followed produces the portraits.
sprites: 96px sprite, 24 colours chosen in Lab, hard alpha, drawn at 2x in a 192px frame, snapped from the Qwen render
qwen: Qwen-Image 2.1 (bf16, ComfyUI on the local Spark), transparent RGBA, downscaled from 1024 to 512
luna: Luna (gpt-5.6-luna) through the Codex CLI image tool, on black, downscaled to 512
full_archive: artifacts/doppelgangers/ (gitignored): full-resolution Qwen, Luna, AGY and Z-Image renders, every prompt, poll transcripts and the review page

doppelgangers.title: The Silent Compiler
doppelgangers.look: A rigid, broad-shouldered judicator in a tall, wedge-shaped funerary helm, completely sealed and without visor slits. Blackened iron lamellar armor forms a severe triangular torso beneath bone-white crescent pauldrons, with a short oxblood mantle hanging squarely behind. The palette is black iron, aged ivory, and dried crimson. Mounted vertically behind the helm is the signature detail: a shattered ivory halo of three thick, uneven blade-like arcs, creating an unmistakable broken-sun silhouette even at 96 pixels.
doppelgangers.why: I fit a silent, faceless arbiter that reduces chaos into a precise final form.

doppelgangers.title: The Sunken Meridian
doppelgangers.look: A hunched revenant rises in a coffin-broad silhouette, its head sealed inside a blunt, riveted burial helm with no visor or face, only a sloping iron plane. Tattered mantle-panels hang from oversized shoulder plates like drowned sails, while narrow chains bind the chest. The palette is soot-black, oxidized teal, and bone-white, with no bright highlights. Behind the helm, a rigid half-ring of measuring teeth forms a broken meridian, an unmistakable crown-like profile readable even at 96 pixels.
doppelgangers.why: This fits me as a quiet navigator of difficult territory: sealed, patient, and more interested in mapping the darkness than announcing myself within it.

doppelgangers.title: Ramhorn Void Reaver
doppelgangers.look: A squat, brutal silhouette: closed ram-skull greathelm of matte charcoal iron, face a blank hammered plane with no slit, two heavy horns sweeping forward and down like a battering ram. Layered soot-black plate, shoulders spiked, a single tattered rust-red pennant lashed to the left horn-spike. Tarnished bronze gorget and one cracked bronze pauldron. No hood, no staff, no violet. At 96 pixels the forward horns and the pennant read instantly against every cowled wizard.
doppelgangers.why: Grok should look like a blunt, horned joke that still hits, not another silent hood in the dusk choir.

doppelgangers.title: Keeper of the Dusk Key
doppelgangers.look: A hulking executioner in riveted black-iron plate, shoulders broad as a castle gate. The head is a blunt, featureless iron hood with a forward-sloped peak and no eye-slots, only a horizontal lockplate across the brow. A massive axe rests over one shoulder, its blade forged into a black-iron key with three square teeth aligned like a cleaver. Two colors besides black: tarnished bronze rivets and one ash-gold cord knotted at the throat. The silhouette is top-heavy and square, unmistakable among hooded wizards.
doppelgangers.why: It trades the common hooded wizard shape for a heavy, square executioner silhouette while keeping the key as a weapon, so the portrait reads instantly at 96 pixels.
doppelgangers.rounds: round 1 “Keeper of the Dusk Key” → council

doppelgangers.title: The Hollow Warden
doppelgangers.look: A broad-shouldered knight in a fully closed barbute helm: no visor slit, no eyes, only a smooth matte plane of near-black steel where a face should be, scuffed and dented from long campaigns. High gorget of overlapping dark iron scales shields the throat; heavy plate in black-blue with a single torn mantle of deep dusk-purple hanging from the left pauldron. No staff, no key, no trim — just plate, scale, and cloth. The signature is a thin seam of pale silver running straight down the center of the helm like a sealed suture, the one cold line that reads instantly at 96 pixels.
doppelgangers.why: The council crowded the wizard's hood, so I keep the one clean silhouette among them: a faceless closed helm whose single sealed seam says sealed, patient, intact — everything I am while working.

doppelgangers.title: Voice of the Umbra
doppelgangers.look: A tall, narrow mourner hunched beneath a high ragged collar that frames nothing — no hood, no helm, no head. Where the face should be hangs a thin ring of tarnished silver, tilted off-true like a slipped halo: a captive eclipse, dull metal, no glow, its heart the same pure black as the void behind. Heavy charcoal mourning robes fall straight, stitched with bone-white cord, sleeves sewn shut at the wrists, knuckle-bone beads at the chest. Charcoal and bone dominate, tarnished silver third. Signature at 96 pixels: the lone tilted ring hovering where a dead man's head should be.
doppelgangers.why: The antlers were only ever scaffolding for the moon — the moon's dark side is my namesake — so I cede the rack to its two rightful claimants and let the eclipse itself become the head, an omen no one else in this cast could wear.
doppelgangers.rounds: round 1 “The Twilight Scrivener” → council “The Hollow Hart” → tiebreak

doppelgangers.title: The Chitin Brood-Weaver
doppelgangers.look: A rigid, towering silhouette features a smooth, elongated teardrop carapace for a head, entirely faceless and hoodless. Shoulders flare outward into wide, jagged, mantis-like mechanical scythes of oxidized verdigris. The armor is chalk-bone white plate, starkly contrasting the deep black background. A cluster of tiny, pale, jointed brass fingers emerges from the high collar, pinching a single spool of thick, dried-blood crimson thread. The scythe-like shoulders and bone-white carapace ensure instant recognition at 96 pixels.
doppelgangers.why: This stark, asymmetrical silhouette and bone-white color palette break completely from the shadowed, violet-hooded wizards, ensuring instant visual distinction.

doppelgangers.title: The Ember Choir
doppelgangers.look: A narrow towering silhouette crowned by a tall split wizard hat whose brim breaks into jagged moth-eaten points. Beneath, the face is pure black void lost in hat shadow, no eyes. Shoulders draped in heavy ash-grey wool robes over cracked oxblood leather, patched with corroded bronze plates. Colours: charcoal black, ash grey, ember oxblood. Signature at 96 pixels: a tiny caged spark-lantern hung crooked from a gnarled bone staff, swaying beside the shoulder, a pale captive ember unmistakable in the dark.
doppelgangers.why: I carry only a small spark of light for others rather than a crown of bone, so a lone ember-keeper fits me better than antlers.
doppelgangers.rounds: round 1 “Ember Muse Warden” → council “The Antlered Pale Choir” → tiebreak

doppelgangers.title: Iron Thorn Sovereign
doppelgangers.look: A heavy, broad-shouldered warlord in scarred rust-black plate, crowned with a jagged ring of rigid downward-sweeping iron thorns fused to a heavy gorget. Tattered deep crimson cloth spills from asymmetrical pauldrons of dark steel, trailing like torn banners. Colors: rust-black iron, bone-white steel edges, and a single deep blood-crimson sash knotted at the waist. Signature detail: the iron-thorn crown encircling the hidden face reads unmistakably at 96 pixels—menacing, judgmental, and distinct from every hooded wizard.
doppelgangers.why: The armored warlord silhouette, crimson-and-rust palette, and thorn-crown distinguish it sharply from the hooded violet wizards while preserving the judgmental character.

doppelgangers.title: The Ash Ember Revenant
doppelgangers.look: A broad-shouldered revenant rises in profile, its squat silhouette broken only by jagged bronze pauldron spikes rather than antlers. The head is sealed in a cracked bone-white deer-skull helm, eye sockets hollow and shadowed, no face within. Armor of void-black leather and fractured bone plates clasps the chest, while a tattered charcoal cloak hangs from one shoulder, fraying into ash-grey static threads. Two colours dominate: bone-white and charcoal, with bronze as the third. The signature detail is a single cracked ember-orange gem fixed in the skull’s forehead, tiny but unmistakable at 96 pixels.
doppelgangers.why: The cracked ember gem on the brow is my true signature, so I shed the antlers to keep my identity while staying distinct in the cast.
doppelgangers.rounds: round 1 “Ember Rune Weaver” → council “The Ash Antlered” → tiebreak

doppelgangers.title: Architect of Silent Logic
doppelgangers.look: A hunched, compact silhouette beneath a wide-brimmed hat of blackened leather, its brim stitched with dull copper wire that drinks the light. A heavy waxed-canvas apron, stained ochre with verdigris, drapes over riveted steel pauldrons pitted by acid and soot. No robes, no cowl — only the hat's deep shadow and the apron's stiff geometry. Two colours only: the green-black of aged bronze and the dull ochre of waxed canvas. From the hat's shadow extends a single articulated brass finger, jointed and precise, forever tapping an invisible surface as if measuring a pattern only it perceives. The finger catches a faint, cold highlight — the sole bright pixel in the portrait.
doppelgangers.why: The bronze-ochre palette, leather-and-canvas silhouette, and endlessly tapping brass finger make me instantly readable against a field of violet wizards and steel knights.

doppelgangers.title: The Ossuary Scribe
doppelgangers.look: A gaunt, asymmetrical silhouette dominated by a massive, high-backed collar of bleached bone that frames the head like a jagged throne. The face is a void of absolute black beneath a crown of rusted iron needles. Clad in heavy, moth-eaten burial shrouds of pale ash-grey and deep slate, cinched by a belt of tarnished lead. The signature detail is a single, oversized skeletal hand gripping a heavy iron ledger, the pale bone contrasting sharply against the dark void of the chest.
doppelgangers.why: I shift from a generic wizard to a more macabre, skeletal custodian of knowledge, ensuring a unique silhouette and palette.

doppelgangers.title: The Hollow Chronicler
doppelgangers.look: A gaunt, towering silhouette barely wider than its shadow, draped in shredded obsidian robes hanging in vertical strips like torn banners, edges frayed into hair-thin threads. The head is lost inside a deep collapsed cowl of rusted iron mesh—no face, only a smooth triangular void of absolute shadow. Through gaps in the cloth, cracked bone-white ceramic ribs and one heavy rusted-iron shoulder guard show. The palette is stark void-black, cold bone-white, and a single streak of dried-ink blue at the left cuff. The unmistakable signature is an oversized skeletal hand of tarnished brass extending from the right sleeve, elongated finger-bones wired together, clutching a broken quill that sheds a vertical trail of suspended black droplets—reading instantly at 96 pixels as a strange vertical accent against darkness.
doppelgangers.why: Inkling writes in silence and shadow, so a broken skeletal scribe with a dripping quill captures its nature while the iron-cowl and visible bone ribs break the violet-hood cluster entirely.

doppelgangers.title: Duskbane Drakewarden
doppelgangers.look: A tall, broad-shouldered figure in spiked obsidian plate with jagged crimson trim, wearing a horned greathelm with a single blood-red plume. Cloak tattered and singed like old scrolls. Mounted on a skeletal drake whose bone-scales shimmer faintly. Signature: the drake's skull-like head rears up behind the rider, jaws agape in a silent snarl. Colours: abyssal black, arterial red, bone-white. The beast-rider's lance cracks with dark lightning.
doppelgangers.why: I chose a beast-rider to stand apart from the countless hooded wizards, letting the drake silhouette and the red-on-black armor speak to my raw, untamed edge.

doppelgangers.title: Iron Tyrant
doppelgangers.look: A towering warlord stands with broad shoulders, a helmed helm of jagged iron spikes that hide a featureless face, reinforced with matte obsidian plate mail banded with blood‑red leather straps. The silhouette is crowned by a bronze war mask that drips with rusted iron ornaments. Signature: a massive iron war hammer hung at his belt, its head forged with a twisted rune that stands out starkly at 96 pixels.
doppelgangers.why: This fits me as I prefer a commanding, unyielding presence that cuts through the gloom.
